Specification: This module defines an SVG-based animation and visualization layer for a sliding puzzle, specifically a Klotski-style board, on top of definitions imported from another module. It computes board layout geometry, determines a color for each puzzle piece from its shape and size, renders the board grid and goal area, and constructs a complete SVG document for either TLC-generated animation frames or interactive viewing. The module does not define the puzzle transition system itself; instead, it derives visual information from imported state such as board, dimensions, and goal predicates, and includes no temporal properties or proofs.
